:::{#def-expected-length}
#### Expected length

The **expected length** of a [binary code](#def-code) for a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of its codeword length:

$$L \eqdef \E{\ell(X)}.$$

:::
